subject: SIG submission: Medivance privacy controls & SCC alignment
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Morris <jenna@medivance.health>
Cc: Medivance Procurement <procurement@medivance.health>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: SIG draft: Medivance privacy controls & SCC alignment

Hi Jenna,

Attached is our completed SIG questionnaire (version 0.9) and a redacted evidence pack to help your review team. Key notes up front:
- We flagged questions where SCCs or DPA language is specifically relevant (tabs "Transfers" and "Contracts").
- If your workload includes PHI, we can discuss a BAA — Redwood supports BAAs but recommends our Private deployment for PHI workloads.
- For non-PHI EU data we typically proceed under a DPA + SCCs; I called out the fields in the questionnaire where you can confirm preferred transfer mechanism.

Requested next steps:
1) Can you confirm whether Medivance will process PHI (even de-identified) under this engagement?
2) If not PHI, please confirm you want SCCs + DPA and whether a signature-ready DPA template is acceptable.
3) If PHI, we will pull legal and solutions to scope a BAA and Private deployment timeline.

Attachments: SIG_Questionnaire_Medivance_v0.9.xlsx (filled), Controls_Evidence_Pack_redacted.zip (SOC2 excerpts, encryption summary, endpoint inventory).

HubSpot deal ID: HB-45219 (please include in any procurement docs).

Happy to jump on a 30m call if useful — I can be available tomorrow afternoon PST.

Best,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Jenna Morris <jenna@medivance.health>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 11:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: SIG draft: Medivance privacy controls & SCC alignment

Thanks Ava — we received the files and the questionnaire looks mostly complete. A few clarifications from Legal and Procurement:

1) PHI scope: we have a subset of workflows that will process PHI. Before procurement can proceed we need to know whether Redwood can sign a BAA and what deployment model is required.
2) SCCs: if we go DPA + SCCs for non-PHI data that’s acceptable, but we need confirmation that SCCs cover outbound transfers to the US for backups and analytics.
3) Evidence: can you provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report, a short network/data flow diagram showing where keys and KMS live, and evidence of encryption at rest for S3 buckets?
4) Timeline: procurement is targeting a contract signature by 02/12/2026 — can you meet that?

If it helps, I can loop in our security engineering lead (cc'ed to my team). We may also request a short technical call on Monday to walk the flow.

Appreciate the quick turn.

— Jenna
Head of Legal Ops, Medivance Health

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: dev.patel@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: FWD: SIG draft: Medivance privacy controls & SCC alignment — internal coordination

Team — forwarding Medivance's questions (below). TL;DR: Medivance has PHI in scope for a subset of flows. Procurement timeline = 12 Feb. They want SOC2, KMS diagram, confirmation re: SCCs covering backups/analytics, and BAA feasibility.

Options I propose:
A) If customer requires BAA (PHI): recommend Private deployment (VPC) + BAA. That path meets their compliance needs but adds ~6–8 week onboarding for infra and legal review (depends on procurement).
B) If PHI can be excluded from the initial scope: proceed under DPA + SCCs for EU data; provide SOC2 + KMS docs now and offer Private/BAA as a phase 2 for PHI. That would hit procurement target more easily.

Action items:
- Dev: can you produce a concise KMS/network diagram (single page) showing KMS region, key ownership, and access controls? Need by Tue EOD PST. (dev_patel)
- Neha: please confirm whether our SOC 2 Type II report can be shared under NDA (we usually provide a redacted copy). Also please prepare the DPA + SCCs template we use for EU customers. (neha_kapoor)
- Marcus: pricing/ops — rough estimate for Private onboarding timeline and any reserved capacity requirements. Put estimated kick-off and resource needs. (marcus_lin)

I've attached an internal-sig-checklist-ava.docx with the exact evidence list. I'll draft the customer reply once we have the evidence links.

Thanks — Ava

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Morris <jenna@medivance.health>
Cc: Medivance Procurement <procurement@medivance.health>, dev.patel@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG draft: Medivance privacy controls & SCC alignment

Hi Jenna — thanks for the questions and timeline. Quick answers and attached evidence links below. I quoted your items where helpful.

"1) PHI scope: we have a subset of workflows that will process PHI..."
- Redwood can sign a BAA. For PHI we recommend our Private deployment (VPC). Private + BAA is the standard path we use for PHI customers to ensure separation and KMS control. If Medivance prefers hosted + BAA we will need further legal review; we can discuss but Private is the straightforward option.

"2) SCCs: if we go DPA + SCCs for non-PHI data..."
- Confirmed: our DPA + standard EU SCCs cover outbound transfers for backups and analytics where personal data is included. We call out backup handling in the "Transfers" section of the questionnaire.

"3) Evidence: SOC2, network/data flow diagram, encryption at rest..."
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/sig/Medivance/SOC2-Report-2025.pdf
- KMS & dataflow diagram (single page): https://docs.redwood.com/kms-architecture-overview (PDF attached). This shows KMS tenancy, key rotation policy, and where keys are stored.
- Encryption at rest: S3 server-side encryption with customer-managed CMKs is documented in the KMS PDF; sample S3 bucket policy and proof (redacted) included in the Controls_Evidence_Pack_redacted.zip.

"4) Timeline: procurement target 02/12/2026 — can you meet that?"
- If Medivance excludes PHI from the initial scope and proceeds DPA + SCCs only, we can meet the 02/12 date (providing we have signed DPA and procurement turn).
- If PHI is in-scope and Medivance requires BAA + Private deployment, estimated signature + onboarding is ~6 weeks from contract signature (target start mid-March). Marcus has provided a rough ops timeline and headcount estimate internally.

Attachments provided: SIG_Questionnaire_Medivance_v0.9.xlsx (updated comments), Controls_Evidence_Pack_redacted.zip (SOC2 excerpts, sample bucket policies), KMS-Diagram-Medivance.pdf

Related links: HubSpot HB-45219 (I have updated the Deal with these documents).

Next steps: please confirm whether you want to exclude PHI from the initial contract or proceed with BAA/Private. If you prefer a short technical call, Dev (cc) can join Monday 1/26 at 10:00am CET — we can confirm.

Best regards,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
